title: Chapter 4 Part 1 Apartments R10 to R60
notes: Apartments (multiple dwellings) in areas coded R10 to R60. Content twin of Chapter 3 for most of Parts 1, 3 and 4, but element numbering differs: 1.3 is communal open space and water is 1.4; there is no 2.10 and no 3.8 retained dwellings; solar access is 3.8 and visual privacy 3.9. The draft calls these dwellings apartments while Table 1.1 says multiple dwellings (register C4P1-002). Regional parking (outside Perth and Peel) has no table in this chapter (C4P1-048).
